mostWorthwhile.text: Filtering the blood and then recovering useful substances showed why the kidney needs both steps, rather than just removing waste.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the ureters and bladder was clear but fairly predictable because the slots and pictures named the connections.

surprise.text: The filter let glucose and other useful small substances through along with waste; it did not just pick out waste.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary: the pictures and goals explained the pairings, including the final collection step.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter to see another body process built up this clearly, though I would hope for some less predictable choices.
